pattern.description: In a split-pane Warp view, the left agent appends its next reasoning paragraph below the 'pwd' step while the right pane's second agent prompt block settles into place with its directory header and accent bar.
pattern.why_premium: Two agents visibly progress in parallel in genuine product UI, so the 'many agents at once' claim is shown, not told; updates are crisp stepped terminal redraws rather than decorative motion.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.fromTo('.left .answer-line', {autoAlpha:0, y:6}, {autoAlpha:1, y:0, duration:0.08, ease:'steps(1)', stagger:0.03}); in parallel gsap.fromTo('.right .prompt-block', {y:12, autoAlpha:0.6}, {y:0, autoAlpha:1, duration:0.15, ease:'power2.out'}), then gsap.from('.right .accent-bar', {autoAlpha:0, duration:0.05}) at the end.
build_hint.remotion: Per answer line: opacity = frame >= lineStart ? 1 : 0 (hard steps, ~1 frame apart); prompt block translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 4], [12, 0], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); accent bar opacity steps to 1 on the last frame.

notes: Very short burst (~0.17 s) with spiky, stepwise energy typical of terminal redraws. Filmstrip thumbnails are small; the right-pane change (header pill to path line, block shift) and the accent bar are inferred. Camera move is none; pan_y is content shift, not camera.
